entries.claim_boundary: This LOCAL-ALGEBRAIC + REDUCED-MODE result gives the first exact counterexample to modewise generic-ell axial Einstein selection in the declared formal radial class. It certifies a non-Einstein rate-zero curvature carrier with finite fixed-representative radial Lee-Wald pairing and an exact defect in the inherited ell=2 lift. It does not construct a global phase space, scattering state, horizon extension, polar result or X2 classification.

dispersion.statement: The counterexample is the rate-zero top axial curvature carrier for real omega!=0.

lee_wald.statement: E0|X0 starts at r^-2 and every X0|X0 coefficient at p>=-1 vanishes exactly after correcting the full metric forcing.

resonance.statement: The carrier, scalar-F and H0 integration resonances are compatible; the inherited fixture instead drops the c' forcing.

taub_maps.statement: No compact Taub map is involved.
